knownNotBuilt.note: Recorded so a reader does not infer these exist from the components that support them. Each is a real gap, not a deferred cleanup.
knownNotBuilt.benchmarkRunner: BUILT but NOT RUN (PR #511). backend/src/ai/benchmarkRunner.ts selects, caps, executes and records cases into model_benchmark_runs. No case has been executed against a live provider — that spends budget nobody authorised — so model_benchmark_runs still has 0 rows, the ledger is still empty, and cost-aware routing still falls back to priors. The runner's tests prove its caps, ordering, stop conditions and isolation rule; they prove nothing about any model's capability.
knownNotBuilt.schedulerImplementationHandlers: CLOSED by PRs #506, #508, #509. Implementation, validation, repair, review and publish now run as canonical scheduler tasks. Request understanding, spec, architecture and task planning still run inside planUniversalRun: they produce real artifacts but are not scheduler tasks, and handlers were deliberately not added for them because hashing a plan and recording it as architecture work is the unearned evidence engineeringTasks.ts exists to prevent.
knownNotBuilt.fineTuningSubmission: learningData.ts enforces the section 26 consent gate, but no interface transmits data to a provider. The gate sits ahead of the capability it guards, which is the correct order.

operationsGrowthReconciliation.meaning: Current executable evidence that the Command 3 agent-intelligence work did not break historical Operations or Growth. This is regression evidence at suite level.
operationsGrowthReconciliation.limitation: Per-requirement re-verification was NOT performed. The 80 ledger entries retain the 'verified' status established at PR #354, and their evidence fields are file and endpoint references rather than executable checks. Claiming eighty individual re-verifications from one suite run would be the fabricated evidence this command forbids; the suites prove the code still works, not that each requirement was re-examined against current production state.

mostRecentUniversalRun.whatWorked: Routing selected glm_5_2 and confirmed the project is allowlisted. Spec, architecture, security controls and acceptance criteria all completed. Incremental implementation generated 17 real files.
mostRecentUniversalRun.whatFailed: The manifest contained 'package.' and 'tsconfig.' with the .json extension dropped — and only from the JSON files; every other extension in the same manifest was correct. 'package.' matches no runtime adapter manifest name, so detectComposition found zero components, planning produced zero validation commands, and the run died at validation reporting 'nothing was executed and no tier was reached'.

mostRecentUniversalRun.fix: PR #510 rejects a malformed plan after one manifest call instead of after seventeen file calls.
